# Code of Conduct

Underthread follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be kind, assume good faith, welcome newcomers and people writing in their second language (English or Chinese are both fine here), and keep criticism about the work, not the person. Harassment, insults, and publishing other people's private information are not accepted.
